title: astragalus rubromarginatus var. oeroilanicus
intro: Astragalus rubromarginatus var. oeroilanicus, commonly known as the Oeroilan milk vetch, is a type of legume plant in the Fabaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote overall health and well-being, with reported health benefits including improved immune function, reduced inflammation, and enhanced cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Oeroilan milk vetch are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Astragalus rubromarginatus var. oeroilanicus include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
